title: Game and season prep
intro: Player views from the season models. Model predictions come from training games, out of fold. Descriptive tables come from training games. Held-out games feed none of them.
counts: {shown} of {total} players are shown. {hidden} are left out because no value clears its minimum sample.

absence.observed: Observed share of games followed by an absence
